name: pando
description: Manage Claude Code worktrees with pando lifecycle metadata, locking, and reaping

delegateCreation.title: Delegate worktree creation to pando

reapOnSessionEnd.description: Unlock and reap eligible ephemeral worktrees owned by the ending Claude Code session.
